From that branch: no-mistakes axi run --wait 8m --intent '<the train: lint baseline (30 force unwraps, no behaviour change, touched files formatted once), BugKit v0.3.0 pin + private CloudKit delivery adoption (container iCloud.com.idvorkin.BugKitReports, started on creation and on every foreground, off in the simulator), story 026 for #249>'. Drive the gates with axi respond (fix for auto-fix findings; approve test with --reason when nothing is live-testable). Rule 4: round 1 fixes every error and warning together; later rounds errors only; cap two rounds, file the rest as issues. At checks-passed: edit the PR body (gh pr edit <n> --body) to record the live checks: step 1's build-sim result and, after step 3, the device deploy. Merge bottom to top with 'gh pr merge <n> --merge', deleting each branch (if only the top PR exists, merging it carries all five commits). The pipeline rebases branches, so 'axi sync' may refuse (inspect_and_reconcile_manually): merge through gh and leave the stale local branches for Igor's word. VERIFY: 'git log origin/main' carries 8125b6b/4b55710/2733a58/5a401e6/c54ef20 or their rebased copies (git range-diff them). DONE WHEN: origin/main has the train and the PR body names the live checks.

description: After step 3. Igor shakes the phone off the Wi-Fi (cellular) and sends a report. Then edit docs/stories/06-feedback.md story 022's Status: the CloudKit delivery entry says verified on the phone, with the date and the issue number; commit on a branch, one pipeline run, merge. Never 'just file-bugs' next to the live listener. VERIFY: at arm time the monitor prints nothing or listener_ok, never listener_missing.
